title: Homology preserves coproducts in the derived module category
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $D(R)$ the derived category of $R$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $q\in\mathbb Z$, any set-indexed family $(E_i)_{i\in I}$ in $D(R)$, and any colimiting cofan $(S,\iota_i)$, the cofan $(H^q(S),H^q(\iota_i))$ is colimiting in the category of $R$-modules. The statement includes arbitrary unbounded complexes and the empty family.

source.place: Lemma lemma-derived-products (Tag 07D9), clauses (1)-(2); cohomology of exact termwise sums as used in perfect.tex, Tag 09M1

proof.text: Import all Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.DerivedAmbientDirectSumsHomology and reuse its already proved private generic shortComplexHomologyColimit theorem. Apply it to ModuleCat R and Discrete I; ModuleCat AB4 supplies exact coproducts. No copy or reproving of the existing generic homology comparison is needed.

Reuse complexHomologyColimit from the same imported module to pass from short-complex homology preservation to cochain-complex homology in degree q. Both reused helpers quantify over an arbitrary abelian category, so no scheme or sheaf assumption enters. Mathlib homologyFunctorFactors identifies Q followed by derived homology with complex homology; transport preservation along this natural isomorphism.

Choose complex representatives K_i of E_i and their localization isomorphisms. Use [lem-pc-derived-module-direct-sums] to obtain the colimit of Q(K_i) with apex Q(∐K_i). Precompose the specified cofan by the representative isomorphisms, and use uniqueness of colimits to identify its apex with Q(∐K_i). Apply homology to this isomorphism and to the termwise-complex coproduct colimit.

Transport the resulting homology colimit along the natural isomorphism whose i-th component is homology of the representative isomorphism. Functoriality gives H(e_i followed by ι_i)=H(e_i) followed by H(ι_i), so the transported cofan has exactly the legs H(ι_i). Package this IsColimit in Nonempty.

theorem derivedModuleHomology_coproduct (R : Type u) [Ring R]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)] (q : ℤ)
    (I : Type u) (E : I → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    (S : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (ι : ∀ i, E i ⟶ S)
    (hι : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) q).obj S)
      (fun i ↦ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) q).map (ι i))))
